name: Signeasy
description: Signeasy sends and tracks electronic-signature envelopes.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Signeasy user through Relay-owned OAuth with exactly rs:read and offline_access and the documented API audience. Relay exposes two fixed pending-envelope metadata reads and blocks people, files, downloads, signing links, audit content, writes, broader scopes, raw access, pagination, polling, retries, and exports.

capabilities.label: List envelopes
capabilities.description: Read a bounded first page of pending-envelope lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Inspect envelope metadata
capabilities.description: Read lifecycle metadata for one explicit pending envelope.

allowed.label: List envelope summaries
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page pending-envelope lifecycle summaries.

allowed.label: Inspect an envelope
allowed.description: Inspect lifecycle metadata for one explicit pending envelope ID.

blocked.label: Access private envelope content
blocked.description: Files, downloads, originals, signed documents, user profiles, recipients, signers, messages, fields, signing URLs, certificates, and audit data are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or sign envelopes
blocked.description: Creating, sending, signing, reminding, voiding, deleting, uploading, and updating are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broader authority
blocked.description: files:read, user:read, create/update/signing-url scopes, templates, webhooks, embedded signing, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only envelope lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: Two bounded envelope reads run automatically with exactly rs:read and offline_access.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Exact scopes, audience, fixed paths, strict projection, result cap, and read-only boundary remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two bounded pending-envelope reads and attaches the exact read-scoped token server-side.
Relay mounts two bounded pending-envelope reads and attaches the exact read-scoped token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's live Signeasy OAuth app, paid live API plan, client credentials, and exact callback/scopes are not configured. No provider-console, credential, consent, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner provisions a live app and suitable plan, configures the exact Railway callback, rs:read plus offline_access, stores credentials through Railway's secret process, deploys separately, and runs live connect, envelope redaction, rotating refresh, revoke/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: Signeasy documents authorization-code OAuth, the fixed audience, access/rotating refresh tokens, refresh exchange, and JSON refresh-token revocation.
Signeasy documents rs:read for pending signature requests and offline_access for refresh tokens, separately from file, user, mutation, signing-link, template, and webhook authority.
Signeasy documents GET /v3/rs/ for listing envelopes.
Signeasy documents GET /v3/rs/{rs_id} for one explicit envelope.
